venue.name: MACC - Meeting Art Craft Center
venue.address: P.za V. Emanuele II, 5, 56125 Pisa PI, Italy
venue.description: A modern conference center located in the heart of Pisa, close to the Pisa Central Station and the historic center of the city.

directions.by_train: 4 minutes walk from the Pisa Centrale train station. High-speed train (Freccia Rossa) connections available via Florence Santa Maria Novella.
directions.by_plane: From Pisa International Airport (approx. 3 km away), take a taxi or the Pisa Mover city train to Pisa Centrale, then a 4-minute walk to the venue.
directions.by_car: Accessible via highways A12 and A11. Closest paid parking is Parcheggio Saba V. Emanuele. A free parking option is Park Pratale (30 minutes walk).

venue.name: Edificio ALFA - Campus Scientifico Università Ca' Foscari
venue.address: Via Torino, 155, 30170 Mestre, Venezia VE, Italy
venue.description: The scientific campus of Ca' Foscari University located in Mestre. It serves as a large hub providing spaces for the tech community to meet, learn, and connect.

directions.by_train: Accessible from the Venezia Mestre train station. From there, you can reach the campus via a short bus ride or a 15-minute walk.
directions.by_plane: From Venice Marco Polo Airport (VCE), take the ATVO or ACTV bus to Mestre, then transfer to a local bus heading to Via Torino.
directions.by_car: Located in the Venice mainland (Mestre). Accessible by car without having to cross into the historic island, with paid parking options available nearby.

venue.name: Hotel Viest
venue.address: Strada della Pelosa, 241, 36100 Vicenza VI, Italy
venue.description: A modern hotel and conference center located near the Vicenza Est exit, providing an excellent venue with multiple tracks and networking areas.

directions.by_train: Accessible from the Vicenza train station via taxi or local public transport.
directions.by_plane: The nearest airports are Venice Marco Polo (VCE) and Verona Villafranca (VRN).
directions.by_car: Located extremely close to the Vicenza Est highway exit (A4). Large parking area available.
